title: The counter that lies
description: A React counter increments once and freezes. Diagnose the stale closure without spoiling the solution.

title: Flexbox holy grail
description: Recreate the classic three-column layout with just flex.

title: Debounce it
description: Implement a debounce function without lodash.

title: Type it
description: Write a fully typed `pick` utility in TypeScript.

title: The banner that jumps
description: A hero banner loads an image and everything below it suddenly shifts down. Track down the layout shift.

title: The tab that gets slower
description: A resizable panel gets laggier the longer the tab stays open. Something isn't being cleaned up.

title: Search results, out of order
description: Typing fast in a search box sometimes shows results for an earlier, already-abandoned query. Fix the race.

title: The button nobody can name
description: A row of icon-only buttons works fine visually but is silent to a screen reader. Find the gap.

title: The grid that can't keep up
description: A product data grid gets laggy on every keystroke elsewhere on the page. Diagnose the unnecessary re-renders.

title: Cannot read properties of undefined
description: A classic runtime crash on page load. Find what's actually undefined before it's mapped.

title: The re-render that won't stop
description: A component re-renders continuously, pinning a CPU core. Find the effect that's triggering itself.

title: The total that isn't a number
description: TypeScript reports zero errors, yet the cart total sometimes renders as NaN in production.

title: The comment that ran a script
description: A comment section is rendering more than just comments. Find and close the gap.

title: The test that tests nothing
description: Every test is green, but a real validation bug still shipped. Find out why the suite couldn't catch it.

title: One bad widget, one blank page
description: A single failing widget takes the entire dashboard down with it. Fix the blast radius.

title: The save that silently failed
description: A Save button shows no error, but nothing actually gets saved. Find the swallowed failure.

title: The error that points nowhere
description: A production stack trace is unreadable minified noise. Fix the build so future errors are actually debuggable.

title: The sidebar that forgot
description: Clicking a sidebar item registers, but the highlight doesn't move. Something's holding a stale snapshot.

title: The style that won't apply
description: A utility class should override a component's color and visibly doesn't. Win the specificity war without !important.
